name: EPIC 212143959

text.card: A red giant 1,013 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 1.02 solar masses and 10.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,778 K at its surface.
